headline: MiniMax jumps 4.3 points in a day while DeepSeek still holds the crown at 31.5%
summary: MiniMax's provider share climbed to 5.2% today, up 4.3 points on the day, and its new m3.1-flash entrant debuted at rank 8. DeepSeek remains the clear leader at 31.5%, though it gave up 4.0 points since yesterday.
highlights: MiniMax's provider share rose 4.3 points in one day to 5.2%, the biggest provider-level shift on the board.
minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash-20261019:free entered at rank 8 with a 4.3% token share, the day's most eye-catching debut.
DeepSeek still leads with 31.5% of tokens, but its share slipped 4.0 points from yesterday.
The top two providers, DeepSeek and Zhipu AI, hold 42.4% between them; adding Anthropic lifts the top three to 50.2%.
Two more new entrants arrived lower down: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-20260630 at rank 37 and openai/gpt-6-astra-20260903 at rank 47.
Dropouts today were mistralai/mistral-nemo, openai/gpt-6-luna-20260922:batch, and deepseek/deepseek-v3.2-20251201.
